revenue_scope: Worldwide: Gilead's residual 'Other' product line, which holds Ranexa together with the products its footnote names
why_separate: Gilead stopped printing Ranexa on its own after 2021Q4; from the first-quarter 2022 release it sits in 'Other', so the figure is the sum of the products the footnote names and not Ranexa's own sales (which are U.S. only).
notes: Rows 2022Q1 to 2023Q4, the quarters in which the footnote reads 'Includes Cayston, Jyseleca, Ranexa and Zydelig.' From the first-quarter 2024 release Letairis is added to the footnote and from the first-quarter 2025 release Ranexa is dropped from it, so later quarters are a different quantity and are not included.
search_log: Pulled data.sec.gov submissions for CIK 0000882095 (recent and older pages); downloaded the Exhibit 99.1 of every Item 2.02 8-K from 2018-02 to 2026-08 (the 2022-02-01 duplicate 8-K from another filer agent and the 2021-01-11 guidance release carry no product table) and parsed the product sales tables.
Downloaded every 10-Q and 10-K filed 2021-02 to 2026-08 and searched the revenue-disaggregation notes for the product; no separate line after the stop dates stated below.
Web search for a partner, licensee or royalty holder printing the product's net sales after the stop (Gilead is sole seller; Atripla JV partner history only in 2010-era 10-K); nothing found.
First-quarter 2022 release (8-K 0000882095-22-000010) and 10-Q: no Ranexa row; footnote (7) on 'Other' names Ranexa.

continuation.evidence: Footnote (7) of the first quarter 2022 release: 'Includes Cayston, Jyseleca, Ranexa and Zydelig.' under the 'Other (7)' U.S., Europe and Other International lines. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882095/000088209522000010/exhibit991earningspressrel.htm
